title: Rosuvastatin in African Americans With Cerebrovascular Disease
brief_summary: This study will assess the rate at which rosuvastatin will achieve LDL targets in African American patients with previous history of stroke or TIA.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age 30 and above
* Rankin score of ≤ 3
* Patient has a fixed telephone number and is available for follow-up
* African American
* Diagnosis of ischemic stroke or TIA in past 12 months

Exclusion Criteria:

* Liver enzyme abnormalities (ALT or AST \>2x ULN)
* Known muscle disorder or CK \> 5x ULN
* Alcoholism or substance abuse
* Stroke due to dissection or hypercoagulable state
* Moderate to severe dementia (MMSE \<20)
* On hemodialysis
* No fixed home address
